name: Authy Desktop
product: Twilio Authy Desktop for macOS

evidence.says: Twilio confirms that Authy Desktop for macOS, Windows and Linux reached end of life on March 19, 2024.

limitation: The final macOS desktop release and its architecture were not established.
notes: The mobile Authy app is a separate product.

name: TomTom MyDrive Connect
product: TomTom MyDrive Connect desktop device manager

evidence.says: TomTom names macOS version 5.1.2.5107 and offers separate Intel, Apple M-series, and Universal builds.
TomTom lists the most recent macOS release of 5.1.2.5107 on December 18, 2025.

name: ShurePlus MOTIV
product: Shure ShurePlus MOTIV Desktop

evidence.says: Shure’s archive ends at version 1.5.4, dated May 13, 2024.
Shure redirects the original MOTIV Desktop product page to its successor, MOTIV Mix.
Homebrew identifies the archived 1.5.4 Mac app as Intel-built and says it requires Rosetta 2.

notes: The final ShurePlus MOTIV Desktop build is Intel-only and remains available through Homebrew’s vendor-hosted download.

name: Memory Clean
product: Memory Clean by FIPLAB

evidence.says: FIPLAB identifies the original Memory Clean as a discontinued app succeeded by Memory Clean 3, now called Memory Meter 3.
FIPLAB documents Memory Clean as its original macOS menu-bar memory optimization utility.

limitation: The final release number and executable architecture were not verified.
notes: Memory Meter 3 is a separate listing candidate.

name: Antelope Launcher
product: Antelope Launcher by Antelope Audio

evidence.says: Antelope Audio confirms native Apple Silicon support for Launcher 3.4.1 with a fresh install or an update from 3.3.26.
Antelope Audio provides a current macOS launcher installer.

notes: An in-place update from a version older than 3.3.26 can leave the Intel build installed, in which case Antelope directs users to reinstall.

name: iBooks Author
product: Apple iBooks Author

evidence.says: Apple says iBooks Author is no longer updated or available to new users and directs authors to Pages.
MacUpdate identifies the last listed release as 2.6.1 and reports Intel 32-bit and 64-bit architectures.

limitation: Apple’s transition notice does not identify the final build’s architecture or release date.
notes: Existing purchasers can retrieve the app from purchase history for use on macOS Catalina or earlier, and Pages can import IBA files.

name: Clear Day Lite
product: Clear Day Lite (Weather HD for Mac) by vimov, LLC

evidence.says: Apple’s US catalog lookup returns no listing for the exact Mac Lite bundle ID.
CoreCode reports Mac App Store removal and lists the last tracked release as 2.0.4 with Intel and i386 architecture.

limitation: No vendor retirement announcement or final executable was available.
notes: This listing covers the Lite Mac edition.

name: PiPer
product: PiPer for Safari by Adam Marcus

evidence.says: The developer describes PiPer 1.0.4 as a Safari extension that adds picture-in-picture buttons to supported websites.
Apple’s catalog matches the extension’s Mac container to bundle ID com.amarcus.PiPer and version 1.0.4.

limitation: The extension itself was not tested on Apple Silicon.
notes: The scanned Mac bundle is the Safari extension’s container.

name: O2_Insight_Pro
product: O2 Insight Pro by Shenzhen Viatom Technology Co., Ltd.

evidence.says: Viatom directs Mac users to the App Store for its O2 Insight Pro device-data viewer.
Apple’s US catalog matches the Mac bundle ID to version 1.9.2, released May 7, 2026.

limitation: The current Mac release’s executable architecture is undocumented and the vendor links only to an App Store download.

name: Tabby
product: Tabby terminal by Eugene Pankov (Eugeny)

evidence.says: The official GitHub API dates the 1.0.238 release to October 7, 2026 and lists separate arm64 and x86_64 macOS builds.
The versioned official release assets include Apple Silicon arm64 and Intel x86_64 macOS installers.

notes: The latest uploaded historical scan used the separately distributed Intel build.

name: i4Tools
product: i4Tools (爱思助手) by Shenzhen i4 Technology

evidence.says: The official product center offers separate Apple-chip and Intel-chip macOS downloads for i4Tools 9.12, dated November 11, 2026.

name: Origin
product: Origin for Mac by Electronic Arts

evidence.says: Electronic Arts confirms that its EA app replaced Origin on both PC and Mac.

limitation: The final Origin for Mac build and its architecture were not independently verified.
notes: The successor EA app is a separate product.

name: RansomWhere_Installer
product: RansomWhere Installer by Objective-See

evidence.says: Objective-See identifies RansomWhere Installer.app as the setup tool for the separately installed RansomWhere.app.

limitation: The installer executable architecture was outside the standalone app audit.
notes: The installed RansomWhere? utility is a separate listing candidate.

name: DeskCover Pro
product: DeskCover, formerly DeskCover Pro, by MacPlus Software / Sergey Gerasimenko

evidence.says: The vendor’s update feed lists 2.1.0 on November 24, 2026, and its 2.0.0 notes announce the DeskCover Pro rename.
Inspection of the vendor ZIP found x86_64 and arm64 slices in DeskCover.app/Contents/MacOS/DeskCover for version 2.1.0, with the original bundle ID.

notes: The vendor now calls the app DeskCover 2 and requires macOS 14 or later.

name: cmdQuit
product: cmdQuit by Diego Arraez (HamacaSoft)

evidence.says: The developer’s Mac App Store listing still offers version 3.9.2, dated March 29, 2016.
The published Mach-O scan of com.diegoarraez.cmdQuit version 3.9.2 records an x86 executable.

limitation: Rosetta 2 runtime behavior was not verified.

name: FeedNotifier
product: Feed Notifier for Mac by Michael Fogleman

evidence.says: Apple’s Mac software catalogue identifies Fogleman’s exact bundle and gives version 1.2 with a November 29, 2012 release date.
The published Mach-O scan of that exact bundle and version records an x86 executable.

limitation: Rosetta 2 runtime behavior was not verified.
notes: The developer-linked GitHub repository describes the Windows edition.

name: EasyRingtones
product: EasyRingtones for Mac by Valeriy Chevtaev

evidence.says: The historical scan identifies Chevtaev’s bundle and records an x86 executable for version 2.0.

limitation: The current or final official release and Rosetta behavior could not be verified.

name: Divvy
product: Divvy window manager for Mac by Mizage

evidence.says: The Mac App Store lists Mizage’s version 1.5.2, released August 23, 2019.
The published scan records x86 for the com.mizage.Divvy version 1.5.2 bundle.
The community device reports identify the exact App Store bundle and version 1.5.2 on Apple Silicon Macs as Intel-only.

limitation: Individual window-management features were not runtime tested during this audit.
notes: Mizage still distributes a separate 1.5.1 build that Homebrew also documents as requiring Rosetta 2.

name: Play Wild
product: WildWorks Animal Jam (Play Wild) desktop installer

evidence.says: The scanned Play Wild version 1.1.10 bundle identifies itself as com.WildWorks.AJPWInstaller.
WildWorks documents that the installer is a separate file to delete after installing the Animal Jam desktop game.

limitation: The installed game’s architecture was not verified.

name: GeekTool
product: GeekTool by Tynsoe

evidence.says: Tynsoe distributes GeekTool 3.4 as its current desktop customization app.
The official ZIP contains GeekTool.app/Contents/MacOS/GeekTool with x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices, and its Info.plist identifies version 3.4, build v3.4-11-g0097512, and the exact bundle ID.

limitation: Inspection covered the main executable.
notes: Older user reports about Rosetta apply to earlier builds.

name: Rearview
product: Rearview – handy mirror camera by Aleksander Popko

evidence.says: Apple’s catalog identifies version 2.3 from June 15, 2020 as the current release for com.aleksanderpopko.Rearview.
The published scan for the same bundle ID and version 2.3 reports only an X86 executable.

limitation: No first-hand Rosetta 2 result or current App Store download inspection was available.
notes: The unrelated Rearview trading backtester is a different product.

name: MP4tools
product: MP4tools 3 by EmmGunn Software

evidence.says: EmmGunn identifies the current MP4tools 3.7.2 download as 64-bit Intel-only and dates the release October 13, 2019.

limitation: No direct report confirmed that this release and its media-processing components work under Rosetta 2.

name: EasyEDA
product: EasyEDA Standard Desktop Client by EasyEDA

evidence.says: EasyEDA's download center lists version 6.5.61 for the Standard edition and distinguishes it from the Pro edition.
Binary inspection of EasyEDA.app/Contents/MacOS/EasyEDA in this official ZIP found an arm64 Mach-O with bundle ID com.easyeda and version 6.5.61.

notes: The official Apple Silicon ZIP is live on the vendor CDN even though the Standard column of the download center displays only its Intel ZIP.

name: Clash for Windows
product: Clash for Windows for macOS by Fndroid (lbyczf)

evidence.says: The community documentation records that development stopped in November 2023 and identifies 0.20.39 as the final release.
The community wiki identifies the deleted official repository and lists separate ARM64 and Intel macOS assets for version 0.20.39.

limitation: Historical documentation records a native final build, but the original official release is unavailable for direct verification.
notes: The Windows branding also covered the official macOS build.

name: CloudBounce
product: CloudBounce desktop audio mastering app by CloudBounce

evidence.says: The CloudBounce team announces its permanent closure on June 30, 2025, and confirms its mastering technology moved into FL Studio.
The reseller confirms that CloudBounce licenses can no longer be activated.

limitation: The final desktop version, its architecture, and the exact desktop shutdown date were not verified.

name: MetaTrader 5
product: MetaTrader 5 for macOS by MetaQuotes (Wine distribution)

evidence.says: MetaQuotes documents that its macOS package runs the x64 desktop terminal inside Wine and supports M-series Macs.
A user reports running the Intel MT5 package on an Apple Silicon Mac, and a developer in the thread identifies Rosetta as the translation layer.
A November 2026 user report describes a running desktop MT5 instance on macOS 27 and the system’s Intel-app warning.

limitation: The live installer does not state the exact desktop build that it fetches, and the runtime reports omit their build numbers.
notes: The App Store mobile edition is a different product.

name: WillMaker
product: Quicken WillMaker Plus 2018 for Mac by Nolo

evidence.says: The Steam community page documents the exact Quicken WillMaker Plus 2018 edition.
Nolo says downloadable year-numbered editions received updates only through their version year.
Nolo describes the historical annual editions and the ongoing Quicken WillMaker & Trust product.

limitation: The final Mac build number and architecture of the 2018 edition were not verified.
notes: The current Quicken WillMaker & Trust release should be assessed separately from the 2018 edition identified by this bundle ID.

name: Seagate Dashboard
product: Seagate Dashboard for Mac by Seagate Technology

evidence.says: Seagate says Dashboard no longer receives updates and discusses migrating supported drives to Toolkit.
Seagate still provides the legacy Mac download on the Dashboard support page.

limitation: The vendor page does not identify the final Mac version or its architecture, and the Mac download exceeds the inspection limit.
notes: Toolkit is a separate product and does not support every Dashboard device.

name: FileWave Admin
product: FileWave Central (FileWave Admin) macOS management console by FileWave

evidence.says: FileWave offers macOS Central (Admin) as a distinct download in the 16.4.3 release.
FileWave explicitly says the Administrator app still requires Rosetta 2.
FileWave identifies Central and Admin as names for the same management console.
FileWave’s official feed dates the 16.4.3 general availability announcement to November 19, 2026.

notes: FileWave Client is a separate component with native Apple Silicon support.

name: DiskLed
product: Disk LED disk activity indicator by Agile Route / Raul Ignacio Verano

evidence.says: The historical Mach-O scans identify the Agile Route bundle and record Intel slices for the scanned 2.1 builds.
Apple’s catalogue returned no match for the original Japanese Mac App Store ID.
The 2011 hands-on review identifies Raul Ignacio Verano and links the original Mac App Store listing.

limitation: A current official build, formal retirement, and Rosetta 2 behavior remain unverified.

name: SteelSeries GG
product: SteelSeries GG 108 for macOS by SteelSeries

evidence.says: SteelSeries documents version 108.3.0 as a macOS-only release on July 31, 2026.
Homebrew identifies 108.3.0 as the current cask and points to the vendor’s Mac installer.
SteelSeries says some GG features may require Rosetta and Apple Silicon support is partial.
SteelSeries ended regular macOS updates and may still issue critical fixes.

limitation: The architecture of the main GG executable remains unverified, and the official 108.3.0 package is about 300 MB.

name: Instatus Out
product: Instatus Out by Instatus

evidence.says: Instatus published the version 1.0.8 Mac download on GitHub on April 10, 2021.
Homebrew identifies that 1.0.8 download as an Intel build that requires Rosetta 2 and marks the cask disabled.
Apple’s US catalog still lists version 1.0.8 for bundle ID com.instatus.out.

limitation: The Intel finding applies to the GitHub download, and successful execution under Rosetta 2 or the App Store binary architecture was not confirmed.
notes: The submitted 1.0.9 does not appear in the public release channels checked.

name: MoonWatch
product: MoonWatch macOS moon-phase menu-bar app by WBrandes

evidence.says: The author distributes a prebuilt MoonWatch.app in the repository's dist directory.
Binary inspection of dist/MoonWatch.app/Contents/MacOS/MoonWatch and its bundled Python 3.9 executable library found only x86_64 in the official 0.2.0 bundle with the matching bundle ID.

limitation: No vendor statement or firsthand compatibility report establishes that the supplied build runs under Rosetta.
notes: The project also distributes source code.

name: Kill
product: Kill by Creative Studio, as identified in the historical bundle

evidence.says: The historical uploaded bundle identifies Kill by Creative Studio, build 1.0.4, and records an Intel x86 binary.

limitation: A current official release, distribution channel, and Apple Silicon behavior could not be established.

name: AntiVirus Sentinel Pro
product: AntiVirus Sentinel Pro by Security Focus Europe

evidence.says: Macworld identifies Security Focus Europe as the vendor and links the original App Store listing, ID 897593583.
Apple’s US catalog returns no listing for the original App Store product ID.
The submitted 3.2.6 bundle matches the exact product ID and contains only an X86 executable.

limitation: The vendor’s retirement notice, last release date and any later private build could not be found.
notes: The original Store ID was also absent from the Canadian, British, German, Australian and Romanian catalogs.

name: Malwarebytes Anti-Malware
product: Malwarebytes Anti-Malware for Mac 1.x by Malwarebytes

evidence.says: Malwarebytes describes its newer Malwarebytes for Mac as a separate app that can coexist with the older Anti-Malware for Mac application.
Malwarebytes staff identify 1.3.1 as the legacy OS X 10.9 release and say it lacks detection available in current versions.
The scan for com.malwarebytes.antimalware 1.3.1 reports only an X86 executable.

limitation: An exact release date and the official end-of-support date for the 1.x bundle were not found.
notes: An archived 1.3.1 DMG remains reachable on the vendor CDN, and Apple Silicon support in newer Malwarebytes for Mac versions applies to the replacement app.

name: WeLinkMeeting
product: HUAWEI CLOUD Meeting for macOS (WeLinkMeeting) by Huawei Technologies

evidence.says: Huawei provides a macOS download for HUAWEI CLOUD Meeting.
Inspection of the vendor DMG found x86_64 and arm64 in WeLinkMeeting.app/Contents/MacOS/WeLinkMeeting, with bundle ID com.huawei.cloudlink and version 12.9.3 (build 12772).
Huawei’s desktop changelog records the original 9.10.5 version under HUAWEI CLOUD Meeting and documents the earlier CloudLink name.

limitation: The Mac release date was not independently established.

name: Descript
product: Descript desktop editor by Descript

evidence.says: Descript's live download endpoint for Apple Silicon redirects to the vendor-hosted arm64 DMG for full editor build 114.0.4-release.20250509.32955.
Homebrew records the same arm64 disk image and associates the app with com.descript.beachcube.
Descript confirms that the macOS editor runs natively on Apple Silicon after installing the Apple Silicon build.

limitation: The build number covers the editor disk image served by the vendor's direct Apple Silicon download endpoint, and the newer in-app update build number was not verified.

name: Filemail
product: Filemail for Mac by Filemail AS, Mac App Store edition

evidence.says: Apple’s US catalog returns no listing for the former Filemail Mac App Store product ID.
CoreCode tracks a Filemail Desktop 4.8.2 download under the separate bundle ID com.electron.filemail-desktop.
Filemail currently offers a Mac desktop app download without stating its version or processor architecture.

limitation: The former Mac App Store edition could not be matched to a current vendor bundle, and the current website installer exceeds the 150 MB inspection limit.
notes: The submitted no.degree.macos.Filemail version 3.26 was Intel-only, and the former App Store product ID was also absent from the Canadian, British, French, Australian, German and Japanese catalogs.

name: Navigation Updater
product: Hyundai Navigation Updater for macOS by Hyundai Motor Company

evidence.says: Hyundai offers a Navigation Updater Mac installer and lists macOS 10.10 or newer without identifying the installed app’s processor architecture or version.
A user reported running Navigation Updater on an M1 Mac with Monterey in April 2022 without identifying the app build or Rosetta status.
Community device reports identify Intel builds of com.hyundai.update, including version 260.526.0.215, on Apple Silicon Macs.

limitation: The newer official Mac installer exceeds 150 MB, and the community reports do not identify the version or architecture it installs.
notes: The app downloads map and vehicle-navigation updates to removable media.
